metadata.notes: Keystone 6 Admin UI with auth package; single User list; SQLite db. Auth example at /examples/auth. Non-admins are redirected to /signin rather than /no-access (auth pageMiddleware always redirects on denied access).

nodes.label: Sign-in page – logo, Name field, Password field, Sign in button
nodes.notes: Redirects to / on success. Shows error notice on invalid credentials.

nodes.label: Init page – empty state after first user created (form not shown)
nodes.notes: Server responds with 302 empty Location; browser stays at /init. No form rendered once users exist.

nodes.label: Init page – 'Create your first user' form shown (no users in DB)
actions: Fill 'Password' group – click 'Set password' then fill New/Confirm inputs
nodes.notes: Only reachable when DB has zero users (initFirstItem condition). Not reachable in seeded state.

nodes.label: No access page – shield icon, 'No access' heading, explanatory text
nodes.notes: Reachable by admins via direct URL. Non-admins redirected to /signin by auth pageMiddleware.

nodes.label: Dashboard – 'Dashboard' heading, Users list card with item count and Add button
actions: Click 'add' button on Users card [role=button, aria-label='add']
Click 'Developer resources' menu trigger [role=button, aria-label='Developer resources']
nodes.notes: Home page. Shows one card per list (only Users in auth example). Unauthenticated → /signin.

nodes.label: Dashboard with developer resources menu open
actions: Click 'API explorer' menu item [role=menuitem, text='API explorer'] → /api/graphql
Click 'GitHub repository' menu item [role=menuitem, text='GitHub repository'] → external
Click 'Community' menu item [role=menuitem, text='Community'] → opens WelcomeDialog
Dismiss menu by pressing Escape or clicking outside
nodes.notes: Only shown in NODE_ENV != 'production'. Menu anchored in nav footer.

nodes.label: Dashboard with Welcome/newsletter subscription dialog open
nodes.notes: Opened from 'Community' item in Developer Resources menu. Newsletter subscription dialog.

nodes.label: Users list – table with name/isAdmin columns, search, filter, column picker, New User button
actions: Click column header to sort (e.g. 'Name' [role=columnheader, text='Name'])
Check row checkbox to select item [role=checkbox in row]
Click row item link to navigate to item page
Click 'Developer resources' menu trigger [role=button, aria-label='Developer resources']
nodes.notes: List view for User list. Sort via column header click. Search is live.

nodes.label: Users list with column selector dropdown open
actions: Toggle column visibility: 'Is Admin' [role=menuitemcheckbox, text='Is Admin']
Dismiss menu by pressing Escape or clicking outside
nodes.notes: Multi-select menu. Columns: name, isAdmin (from User list initialColumns config).

nodes.label: Users list with 'Add filter' popover open – field picker step
actions: Select filter field from picker [role=listbox or combobox] e.g. 'Is Admin'
Dismiss by pressing Escape or clicking outside
nodes.notes: Step 1 of 2: pick which field to filter. Only filterable fields shown.

nodes.label: Users list with 'Add filter' popover – value/type input step
actions: Click 'Apply' / submit button to add filter [role=button]
nodes.notes: Step 2 of 2: pick filter type and value. Appears after selecting field in step 1.

nodes.label: Users list with inline filter-edit popover open on an active filter tag
nodes.notes: Clicking an active filter tag that has editable value opens this popover.

nodes.label: Users list with ≥1 rows selected – ActionBar visible at bottom
actions: Click 'Delete' action item in ActionBar [role=button, text='Delete']
Click clear selection button [aria-label='Clear selection'] in ActionBar
Toggle additional checkboxes to add/remove items from selection
Click 'Select all' checkbox in table header [role=checkbox in thead]
nodes.notes: Selection triggers ActionBar overlay. Delete is the default action for Users list.

nodes.label: Users list with bulk-delete AlertDialog open
actions: Click 'Yes, delete' primary action button [role=button, text='Yes, delete']
nodes.notes: AlertDialog: 'Are you sure you want to delete {count} {user|users}?'

nodes.label: Users list with action error details Dialog open
actions: Click dismiss / close button to close dialog [role=button, aria-label='Dismiss']
Click item link to go to item page [role=link in dialog]
nodes.notes: Shown when bulk action partially fails. Contains per-item error details.

nodes.label: Create User form – Name, Password group, Create button
actions: Click 'Set password' button in Password group [role=button, text='Set password']
nodes.notes: Submitting creates user and navigates to /users/:id. 'Set password' button expands password inputs.

nodes.label: Create User form with password fields visible (New / Confirm inputs shown)
actions: Toggle password visibility icon [role=button, aria-label contains 'show/hide']
nodes.notes: Password group expands to New + Confirm inputs after 'Set password' click.

nodes.label: User item page – Name (read/edit), Is Admin checkbox, Password group, Save (disabled), Reset (disabled)
actions: Click 'Set password' / 'Change password' button in Password group
Click 'Save' button [role=button, text='Save'] – disabled until changes
Click 'Reset' button [role=button, text='Reset'] – disabled until changes
nodes.notes: Save/Reset disabled until a field is edited. Delete visible for admins only (hideDelete check).

nodes.label: User item page with pending edits – Save and Reset buttons enabled
nodes.notes: Save/Reset become enabled when any field is changed from its persisted value.

nodes.label: User item page with delete AlertDialog open
actions: Click 'Yes, delete' [role=button, text='Yes, delete'] – confirms deletion → navigates to /users
nodes.notes: AlertDialog: 'Are you sure you want to delete itemLabel?'

nodes.label: User item page with reset-changes AlertDialog open
actions: Click 'Yes, reset' [role=button, text='Yes, reset'] – discards edits
nodes.notes: AlertDialog: 'Are you sure? Any unsaved changes will be lost and cannot be recovered.'

nodes.label: User item page with error-details Dialog open (save or delete failed)
actions: Dismiss error dialog [role=button, aria-label='Dismiss' or clicking outside]
nodes.notes: Shown via toast 'Details' action button after save/delete error. Contains stack trace.

nodes.label: User item page – 'Not found' state when ID does not exist
nodes.notes: Renders ItemPage with 'Not found' heading when GraphQL returns null for the given ID.

link 'Users' heading in list card [role=link in h3]
button 'Developer resources' [role=button, aria-label='Developer resources'] in nav footer

link in table row [role=link, text=user name]

edges.guard: An active filter with editable value exists on the list

edges.trigger: button 'Clear selection' [role=button, aria-label='Clear selection'] in ActionBar
item 'Delete' in ActionBar [role=menuitem or button, text='Delete']
button 'Yes, delete' [role=button, text='Yes, delete'] or button 'Cancel' [role=button, text='Cancel']
auto: on delete failure, toast action 'Details' button triggers error dialog
edges.guard: GraphQL mutation error occurs during bulk delete

edges.guard: Form valid: name provided, password set and matching

press Escape when New + Confirm inputs are both empty
Edit any field (e.g. toggle 'Is Admin' checkbox, edit 'Name' field)
button 'Yes, reset' [role=button, text='Yes, reset'] or button 'Cancel' [role=button, text='Cancel']

edges.guard: Admin user (hideDelete returns false for admins)

edges.trigger: auto: toast 'Details' action button after delete failure
auto: toast 'Details' action button after save failure
dismiss dialog [role=button, aria-label='Dismiss'] or click outside
auto: redirect on unauthenticated or expired session
button 'Sign out' [role=button, text='Sign out'] in nav footer
button 'Sign out' [role=button, text='Sign out'] in nav footer
button 'Sign out' [role=button, text='Sign out'] in nav footer

auth_zones.label: No-access page – rendered when isAccessAllowed=false but no pageMiddleware redirect

layouts.label: Auth layout – centered form, logo at top, no sidebar navigation
Admin layout – left sidebar nav (Dashboard + list links + sign-out + dev menu), main content area
Standalone error page – no layout wrapper
